_comment: Illustrative defaults, not survey-calibrated. closed_months models the summer holiday via the generic fixed_schedule param -- no bespoke Python calendar logic needed. gain_w_per_m2 (9 W/m^2) approximates ASHRAE 90.1 Table 9.5.1 school/university lighting power density (~0.87 W/ft^2 ~ 9.4 W/m^2), rounded. Blended with (not replacing) the per-occupant gains -- see core/buem_adapter.py to_buem_profiles().
description: Primary/secondary school. Weekday term-time hours, closed weekends and July-August.
